description: This file implements secure credential storage with encryption, key management, and file handling, including functions for encrypting/decrypting data, managing encryption keys via OS keyring or local files, and saving/loading encrypted credentials.

methods.name: get_or_create_key
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a 256-bit encryption key, attempting to use OS keyring, local file, or generating a new key if none exists.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext bytes using AES-256-GCM, prepending a nonce to the ciphertext.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data produced by `encrypt()`, handling errors for invalid or tampered data.

methods.name: encrypted_credentials_path
methods.description: Returns the file path for storing encrypted credentials.

methods.name: save_encrypted
methods.description: Encrypts and atomically saves JSON credentials to a file with secure permissions.

methods.name: load_encrypted_from_path
methods.description: Loads and decrypts credentials JSON from a specified file path.

methods.name: load_encrypted
methods.description: Loads and decrypts credentials JSON from the default encrypted credentials file.
